component.name: Frame Player
component.summary: Hardware-accelerated 8K, 3D, and VR video for Steam Frame

description.p: Frame Player opens YouTube, Twitch, HLS, DASH, and direct video URLs on Steam Frame. It decodes with Qualcomm Iris when the stream is H.264, HEVC, or VP9 up to 8192 pixels, and falls back to the CPU otherwise.
Side-by-side and over-under 3D, plus 360° and 180° VR, are shown in the desktop window with eye selection and look-around controls that work with a pointer or a gamepad.
